skill.name: ckm-brand
skill.description: Create and maintain brand guidelines, voice rules, design tokens, and asset checks for consistent marketing work.
skill.summary: Brand system guidance for voice, visual identity, messaging, design tokens, and asset validation.
skill.author: nextlevelbuilder

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown examples, CSS snippets, regex methods, JavaScript template literals, and expected local file operations. I confirmed command-execution risk in sync-brand-to-tokens.cjs because it imports child_process and uses execSync to run a project-local token generator through the shell. The prompt context helper also needs clearer handling of editable brand text as untrusted data.

remediation.suggestion: Replace execSync string commands with execFileSync or spawnFileSync using argument arrays. Require confirmation before running project-local generator scripts.
Do not build copy-paste shell commands with raw file paths. Display separate arguments or apply robust shell escaping before presenting commands.

remediation.issue: Prompt context built from editable brand files
remediation.suggestion: Delimit imported brand text as untrusted data. Filter prompt-control phrases before adding brand content to generated instructions.

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when voice, colors, and assets drift across channels. This skill provides brand guides, token sync, and asset checks for consistent output.
actual_capabilities: Draft structured brand guidelines with voice, colors, typography, logo rules, imagery, and messaging sections.
Review content and assets against brand consistency checklists.
Extract colors and typography from a local brand guidelines file.
Validate local asset filenames, file sizes, formats, and manifest registration.
Sync documented brand colors into design token files.
Provide templates for brand updates, approvals, and starter guidelines.
limitations: It depends on accurate brand source documents supplied by the user.
Image color extraction provides command guidance and may need external tools.
Token sync assumes the project uses the expected docs and assets paths.
It does not replace legal, trademark, or accessibility review.

use_cases.title: Standardize Campaign Assets
use_cases.description: Review banners, social graphics, and email headers against naming, color, and approval rules before launch.

use_cases.title: Document Visual Identity
use_cases.description: Create a practical brand guide that covers colors, typography, logo usage, imagery, and voice.

use_cases.title: Sync Brand Tokens
use_cases.description: Turn documented brand colors into design token files for product and website implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Starter Guide
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new brand.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a starter brand guide for our product. Include voice, colors, typography, logo rules, imagery, and approval steps.

prompt_templates.title: Review Campaign Copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this campaign copy against our brand voice. Identify off-brand phrases, unclear claims, and stronger alternatives.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Visual Assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these asset descriptions against our visual identity. Check naming, format, color use, logo handling, and approval readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Update and Sync Tokens
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for brand system changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update our brand guidelines with the new palette, then prepare a token sync plan with risks, files touched, and verification steps.

output_examples.input: Review a social banner for a product launch.
output: The asset name should include type, campaign, description, date, and variant.
The primary call to action uses the approved blue and meets contrast guidance.
The logo needs more clear space before final approval.

output_examples.input: Create brand voice rules for a professional software company.
output: Voice traits: professional, helpful, clear, and confident.
Use direct benefit statements and avoid vague superlatives.
Adapt tone by channel while keeping the same core personality.

output_examples.input: Prepare a brand refresh handoff for developers.
output: Brand source document updated with palette and typography decisions.
Design token sync plan lists expected token files and review checks.
Accessibility review remains required before production release.

best_practices: Keep docs/brand-guidelines.md current before running reviews or sync tasks.
Provide approved source assets and clear campaign names.
Review generated changes before publishing brand or token updates.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without a source brand guide.
Treating automated asset checks as final approval.
Running token sync in a project with unexpected file paths.

faq.question: Does this skill create a complete brand guide?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides templates and structure for voice, visual identity, messaging, assets, and approval workflows.

faq.question: Can it validate real design files?
faq.answer: It can validate local filenames, file sizes, formats, and manifest registration. It does not inspect layered design content.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: Can it sync colors to design tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. The included sync script reads documented brand colors and updates token files in expected project paths.

faq.question: Does it check accessibility?
faq.answer: It provides accessibility checklists and contrast guidance, but final accessibility testing remains the user responsibility.

faq.question: What inputs should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide brand guidelines, campaign goals, asset paths, approved colors, typography choices, and any required approval rules.
